u1259.line: Farmer ID (Digital Agriculture Mission): 11 crore created by 23 Oct 2026; deadline for 11 crore IDs was 31 March 2027. Gives farmers one digital identity.
u1259.hook: Farmer ID = one digital identity that opens four doors: government schemes, bank credit, crop insurance, disaster relief.

u1260.line: India elected FATF Vice-President for the first time (June 2026): Vivek Aggarwal, July 2026 to June 2027. Next FATF President from July 1, 2026: Giles Thomson.
u1260.trap: Vivek Aggarwal = FATF Vice-President; Giles Thomson = next FATF President.

u1261.line: Osmania University, Hyderabad → India's first university to receive four ISO certifications at once, granted by BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards).
hindi: Bureau of Indian Standards (भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो)

u1262.trap: 1855 is the Census 2027 helpline number, not a year.

u1263.line: India-AI Impact Summit 2026 → Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi (16-21 February 2026), by MeitY; three Sutras: People, Planet, Progress; seven themes: the Seven Chakras.
u1263.hook: Three Ps = three Sutras (People, Planet, Progress); seven themes = Seven Chakras.

u1264.line: World Mental Health Day → 10 October every year.

u1265.line: Khalilur Rahman (Bangladesh) → elected President of the UN General Assembly's 81st session, defeating Andreas Kakouris (Cyprus); term starts 8 September 2026.

u1266.line: QS World University Rankings 2027: MIT keeps global top spot; IIT Delhi tops India at 118th; 52 Indian universities included.
u1266.trap: 118th = IIT Delhi's global rank; 52 = number of Indian universities ranked.

u1267.line: 16th edition of the QS World University Rankings by Subject released; QS headquarters → London, United Kingdom.
u1267.trap: Don't confuse the subject-wise QS ranking (16th edition) with the overall QS World University Rankings.

u1269.line: Peter Paul Rubens' 400-year-old painting 'Christ on the Cross' → auctioned for 2.3 million euros ($2.7 million).

u1270.line: BSE Saatvik 100 → India's first Saatvik Index, launched by BSE.

u1271.line: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) → India's 28th Navratna CPSE, upgraded by the Department of Public Enterprises; FY26 turnover Rs. 59,400 crore.

u1272.line: Global Startup Ecosystem Report (GSER) 2026, by Startup Genome: Silicon Valley first; Bengaluru 15th; Beijing → Asia's top AI-native cluster.
u1272.trap: Silicon Valley = first overall; Beijing = top AI-native cluster in Asia only.

u1275.line: India's first integrated Basmati and Organic Training Centre-cum-Demonstration Farm → being set up in Pilibhit, Uttar Pradesh.

u1284.line: India's first commercial Mini/Micro-LED display facility → to be set up at Dholera, Gujarat.

u1285.line: New Ramsar sites: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah, UP) and Chhari-Dhand (Kutch, Gujarat); 99th was Shekha Jheel (Aligarh, UP). At 100 sites India: third globally, first in Asia.
u1285.hook: Two UP bird sanctuaries: Shekha Jheel (Aligarh) = 99th site; Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah) = newly added.
u1285.trap: Patna Bird Sanctuary is in Etah district, Uttar Pradesh, not in Bihar.

u1286.line: India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0 → announced in Union Budget 2026–27 with an initial provision of ₹1,000 crore.

u1288.line: World Environment Day → June 5 every year.

u1290.line: 35th Saraswati Samman (for 2025) → Ramkumar Mukhopadhyay, for 'Hara Parbati Katha'.
u1290.trap: 35th is the edition number; 2025 is the award year. Don't mix them.

u1291.line: Forbes' World's Billionaires List 2026 → Elon Musk is the world's richest person.

u1293.line: Bihar Day → 22 March; 2026 theme 'Unnat Bihar, Ujjwal Bihar' (Progressive Bihar, Bright Bihar).

u1294.line: 68th National Productivity Week → 12–18 February 2026; theme 'Clusters as Growth Engine: Maximizing Productivity in MSMEs'.

u1295.line: World Pulses Day → 10 February; 2026 theme 'Pulses of the World: from Modesty to Excellence'.

u1296.line: World Wetlands Day → 2 February; 2026 theme 'Wetlands and Traditional Knowledge: Celebrating Cultural Heritage'.

u1299.line: National Pollution Control Day → 2 December; 2025 theme 'Sustainable Living for a Greener Future'.

u1300.line: International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women → 25 November.
hindi: Violence against women (महिलाओं के विरुद्ध हिंसा)

u1301.line: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi → fastest-ever List A half-century: 11 balls vs Sri Lanka A, breaking Kaushalya Weeraratne's record (50 runs in 12 balls).
u1301.trap: 11 balls = new record (Sooryavanshi); 12 balls = old record (Weeraratne).

u1305.line: Indian Space Industry E-Catalogue (India's first digital repository of space-sector capabilities) → launched at the 5th Indian Space Congress (ISC) 2026, New Delhi.

u1306.line: Sanae Takaichi (Liberal Democratic Party, LDP) → Japan's first woman Prime Minister; PM Modi congratulated her on her historic win in Japan's House of Representatives elections.

u1307.line: CM Yogi Adityanath → launched the Uttar Pradesh Startup Policy, 2026 and the Uttar Pradesh Startup Mission Portal in Lucknow.

u1308.line: WEF Energy Transition Index 2026: Sweden top (then Finland, Denmark); India 70th; Democratic Republic of the Congo last (120th).
u1308.trap: India = 70th; 120th = last place (Democratic Republic of the Congo).

u1309.line: SRS Bulletin 2024 (by ORGI, Home Ministry): birth rate 21 (2014) → 18.3 (2024); death rate 6.7 → 6.4 per 1,000 population. SRS = large-scale demographic survey.
u1309.hook: SRS = Sample Registration System; ORGI = Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India.
u1309.trap: Birth rate pair: 21 → 18.3; death rate pair: 6.7 → 6.4. ORGI is under the Ministry of Home Affairs, not the Health Ministry.

u1310.line: Maharashtra → first Indian state to launch dedicated menopause clinics. World Menopause Day → 18 October every year.

u1311.line: 2026 Pulitzer Prize for Illustrated Reporting and Commentary → Indian contributors Anand RK and Suparna Sharma among the winners.
